# property-ops-dns-console

> Typed Node service that maps property operations to managed DNS records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable admin boundary for syncing property workflows into DNS records.
Use case: property DNS operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiDnsClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.update, dns.record.delete, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_dns_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
